top_signals.title: How to Stop China from Freeriding on American AI
top_signals.summary:
The release of the Chinese open-weight AI model Kimi K3 has compressed a year’s worth of unresolved AI policy debate into a single news cycle. top_signals.title: New DOUBLECUP ClickFix service hides malware in browser cache images
top_signals.summary: A new Russian loader-as-a-service named DOUBLECUP uses ClickFix attacks to hide malicious code in PNG images cached by victims' browsers, ultimately delivering CountLoader to Windows and macOS devices and a new remote access trojan named DeviceManager to Windows systems. [...]

top_signals.title: Varonis Agent IBAC keeps AI agents within their intended boundaries
top_signals.summary: AI agents need broad access to be useful, but traditional access controls cannot determine whether an action aligns with a user's intent. Varonis explains how Agent IBAC detects intent drift and enforces real-time guardrails to keep agents within their intended boundaries. [...]
